thread:
Jonah Kim: Quick a11y catch from today's dark-theme QA: table row hover uses a 8% lighter bg which is invisible in dark mode. Hard to tell which row is focused when using keyboard.
Priya Singh: Oh nice find. Is that also affecting focus outlines or only hover?
Jonah Kim: Both. Hover/bg change is subtle, and our focus ring is a 2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.6) which disappears on dark backgrounds. NVDA reads rows fine but keyboard users rely on visible focus.
Dmitri Kozlov: Suggestion: invert the approach in dark modeuse an outline or box-shadow with a light color instead of dark outline. Something like box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.12) or a solid 3px #e6f0ff if contrast works.
Priya Singh: Can you run a contrast calc? Need 3:1 for focus ring per WCAG 2.1 for non-text UI.
Jonah Kim: Ran a quick check: #e6f0ff on #0b0f15 is 4.2:1. Good enough. I'll try that.
Maya Patel: Also noticed table icons (info, link) don't have accessible names. Screen reader reads "graphic". Please add aria-label or aria-describedby.
Dmitri Kozlov: Agreed. For icon-only buttons use <button aria-label="Open details"> or add visually-hidden text. Avoid role="img" unless decorative and aria-hidden.
Priya Singh: Minor but important: when opening a details flyout from a row, NVDA announces the flyout but then focus jumps to the body. We should focus the first heading in the flyout and add aria-modal if it's acting like a dialog.
a11y-bot: Auto-scan: table-hover-color low contrast in dark theme ❌; icon buttons missing accessible name ❌; focus-outline contrast 2.0:1 ⚠️. Report: https://redwood-internal/a11y/1969991234
Jonah Kim: Plan: 1) Add dark-mode focus token: --focus-ring-dark: 3px solid #e6f0ff; 2) Replace hover bg with subtle gradient or 6% lighter; 3) Add aria-labels to icon buttons; 4) Flyout: set role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus first h2 tabindex='-1'. I'll open a PR with screenshots for default + high-contrast.
Maya Patel: Please include Playwright keyboard test that tabs to a row, hits Enter to open flyout, asserts document.activeElement is flyout heading. Also include NVDA manual step in the PR description.
Jonah Kim: Will do. Adding @eng-runtime in case CSS layering for focus ring needs global_zindex tweak.
Priya Singh: Thanks! Small change but big UX impact.
Maya Patel: Love it. Put the PR link here when ready and we'll queue for design review. :white_check_mark:
